thresholds.supported: MRR(structural) > MRR(m) for every baseline m AND hits_at_1(structural) >= 2
thresholds.provisional: MRR(structural) > MRR(m) for at least 3 of 4 baselines AND hits_at_3(structural) >= 2

suppression_rule: structural matches with fewer than 2 shared anchors are suppressed as weak or topical
claim_ceiling: provisional / domain_specific at n=14 curated trajectories; transferable requires live-capture replication in a later epoch
